s3-suspect.desc: a young man in a red cap

s3-rival-vendor.desc: a vendor from the next aisle

go-between-courier.desc: a courier in a gray jacket

steps.line: {burnout-officer} walks the market plaza slowly, hands in pockets, past corners without scanning them.
Shoppers scatter from the lantern stall as flames run up the awning, and {s3-stall-owner} stays put.
{s3-stall-owner} points {burnout-officer} at the burning awning, apron balled in one fist.
{s3-stall-owner} points at a melted power strip under the counter.
{burnout-officer} stands at the scorched stall as the smoke thins out.
{burnout-officer} picks a melted gel cap off the ground and drops it in an evidence bag.
{burnout-officer} sits on a plaza seat in mid-afternoon, eating noodles from a carton.
{burnout-officer} reads the fire log: "Gel residue on the awning struts. Strip melted after ignition."
{s3-stall-owner} tells {burnout-officer} a man came by Thursday and said "the usual."
{burnout-officer} reads the same log line a third time, lips moving.
{s3-rival-vendor} shouts at {s3-stall-owner} across the aisle, loud enough to turn heads.
{s3-rival-vendor} jabs a finger at the scorched stall.
{s3-rival-vendor} walks back to the next aisle, still muttering.
{burnout-officer} eats alone at the food counter in the middle of the afternoon.
{go-between-courier} hands {s3-suspect} a folded paper bag at the end of the counter.
{s3-suspect} walks off toward the market plaza, the bag under {s3-suspect.his} arm.
{burnout-officer} looks up from the bowl, shrugs, and goes back to eating.
{burnout-officer} crouches under the burned counter and sifts the ash with a pen.
{burnout-officer} lifts out a scorched paper corner with one printed digit still showing.
{burnout-officer} unfolds a note from under the counter: "Pay Thu, 20."
{s3-suspect} stands at the Neon Dome snack stand hatch, hands in {s3-suspect.his} pockets.
{s3-suspect} and {informant} hug across the hatch counter.
{informant} slides a snack token across the hatch to {s3-suspect}.
{s3-suspect} pockets the token and walks off into the Dome crowd.
{s3-rival-vendor} digs a receipt out of a jacket pocket and hands it to {burnout-officer}.
{burnout-officer} reads the receipt, stamped "22:15" at the food counter on the night of the fire.
{burnout-officer} sits down on a counter stool with the receipt in hand.
{burnout-officer} shrugs at {s3-rival-vendor} and slides the receipt back along the counter.
{burnout-officer} sits on a plaza seat facing the burnt stall, not eating, not moving.
{s3-suspect} stops beside the burnt stall in a red cap, hands in {s3-suspect.his} pockets.
{burnout-officer} stands up, and {s3-suspect} breaks into a run across the plaza.
{burnout-officer} catches {s3-suspect} by the collar at the edge of the plaza.
{burnout-officer} pulls a gel vial and half of a scorched paper stub from {s3-suspect}'s pocket.
{burnout-officer} walks {s3-suspect} out of the plaza toward the station.
{s3-suspect} sits at the interview table, the red cap turning in {s3-suspect.his} hands.
{s3-suspect} tells {burnout-officer} a courier paid {s3-suspect.him} twenty credits and a cousin said the stall had refused.
{burnout-officer} hands the gel vial in its evidence bag to {desk-sergeant}.
{burnout-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant} over a shift swap, voice low and flat.
{burnout-officer} shrugs and turns away from {desk-sergeant}'s desk.
{burnout-officer} reads the leave sheet on the wall three times without signing it.
{burnout-officer} sits on the lobby bench, hands hanging between {burnout-officer.his} knees.
{burnout-officer} scans each plaza corner with the handheld, one after another.
{s3-stall-owner} steps under a new awning at the rebuilt lantern stall.
{s3-stall-owner} hands {burnout-officer} a lidded bowl over the counter.
{burnout-officer} eats from the bowl standing at the stall counter.
